scripts.prepare: wxt prepare bench && wxt prepare extension
scripts.build: npm run fetch:libs && wxt build extension
scripts.zip: npm run fetch:libs && wxt zip extension
scripts.build:e2e: npm run fetch:libs && wxt build extension --mode e2e
scripts.build:smoke: npm run fetch:libs && wxt build extension --mode smoke
scripts.bench:build: npm run bench:fetch:libs && wxt build bench
scripts.bench:zip: npm run bench:fetch:libs && wxt zip bench
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:e2e && npm run bench:build && playwright test --trace off
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:smoke && playwright test --config tests/smoke/playwright.config.ts --trace off
